model_run.provider_usage_note: Per-packet provider billing-token counts are unavailable in this ChatGPT surface and are not estimated.
model_run.answer_policy: Only packet-visible FeynMap evidence was used in committed answers; source-body facts remembered from fixture authoring were deliberately not reconstructed.

relative_context_reduction.interpretation: FeynMap deterministic compact-JSON char/4 estimate only; not provider billing tokens.

missing_identifier_control.interpretation: P2.3a gives the stronger substrate-level unknown signal; the conservative downstream development answer also abstained under legacy after observing no issue_refund evidence.

shipping_gates.why_comparative_gate_is_not_quality_succ: Both policies tied at 0.0 required-claim recall, had no trap/citation regressions, handled the missing identifier conservatively, and symbol_evidence was cheaper. Relative no-regression therefore passes mechanically even though neither arm answered any preauthored behavioral task fully.

primary_finding: P2.3a repaired task-bearing symbol selection, but the current model-facing compact semantic payload usually exposes symbol identity and graph relationships rather than the source-body behavioral facts required by downstream implementation questions. Correct symbol delivery is therefore necessary but not sufficient for answer fidelity.
observed_examples: reserve_order and ensure_stock were delivered with a real call edge, but mutation ordering and return-value construction were not represented in the compact payload.
apply_priority_default and priority_default were delivered, but the literal normal default and preserve-existing behavior were absent from model-facing evidence.
cancel_order and can_cancel were delivered, but the queued/packed literal set and no-refund behavior were absent.
formatShipmentStatus and normalizeStatus were delivered, but the JavaScript call/import relationship and trim/toUpperCase body semantics were absent.
symbol_evidence correctly represented absent issue_refund as unresolved and insufficient; legacy incorrectly reported sufficient at the substrate level.

decision.next_checkpoint: Grounded behavioral evidence delivery: expose compact source-body facts/snippets or normalized source assertions for selected symbols, preserve source provenance and unknown semantics, then rerun a newly frozen downstream-fidelity corpus before any default promotion or S7 outcome claims.

limitations: The fulfillment corpus is fresh and preauthored but synthetic and not externally reviewed.
The GPT-5.6 Sol development run was not blind to the fixture/oracle and cannot support a shipping promotion.
The lexical required-claim/trap scorer is intentionally bounded and not exhaustive semantic fact checking.

Zero required-claim recall here measures inability to produce the preregistered behavioral claims from the compact packet under the conservative answer protocol; it is not a general-purpose model accuracy measurement.
No actual provider billing-token usage was available; context sizes are FeynMap deterministic estimates.
